worldFact.fact: Guinness lists Buñol's La Tomatina as the world's largest annual food fight. At least 40 tonnes of ripe tomatoes are hurled through the streets of this small Valencian town, and at its 2012 peak an estimated 40,000 people joined in.

photo.alt: Ex-SE&CR 0-4-4T shunting on Admiralty Pier at Dover. View NE, across the Harbour to the cliffs towards Langdon Bay and South Foreland - nowadays the Eastern Docks would be much more prominent. The locomotive is Wainwright H class 0-4-4T No. 31540 (built 11/1904 as No. 540, withdrawn 2/60).
